product_metadata.title: Maytex Shower Curtain Hooks, Shower Curtain Rings, Rust-Resistant Decorative Double Roller Glide Shower Hooks, Shower Rings for Bathroom Shower Rods, Curtains, Liners, Set of 12, Oil Rubbed Bronze
features: EASY ROLLER GLIDE DESIGN: Roller shower curtain hooks feature an easy gliding 5-ball top that allows them to effortlessly glide across your shower rod with less noise

INNOVATIVE DOUBLE HOOK TECHNOLOGY: Double hook design separates your shower curtain and liner and makes them easy to replace; use the secondary hook to hang shower accessories, FRICTION FREE: These shower curtain hooks will quietly glide across the curtain rod
QUICK INSTALLATION ON YOUR SHOWER ROD: Non-clasp closure requires no pinching and is easy to install on any standard shower rod
RUST-RESISTANT OIL RUBBED BRONZE FINISH: Durable metal construction with a rich oil rubbed bronze finish that resists rust
SET OF 12 SHOWER HOOKS: Sold in sets of 12 shower rings to match the number of holes in your curtain and liner
PACKAGING: Item should come in Maytex branded packaging such as packaging pictured on left
description: The Maytex Rust-Resistant Metal Double Roller Glide Shower Hooks make it easy to hang both a shower curtain and shower liner separately. Their unique double-sided design also allows you to change or replace a curtain or liner quickly, and helps promote ventilation so your curtain and liner dry faster. The rust-resistant shower hooks have five rolling balls at the top that allow them to glide easily and quietly along your shower rod while their innovative shape keeps them secure. The hooks feature an attractive oil rubbed bronze finish for style.
